meta.name: how-it-works
meta.description: Explain how claude-mem captures observations, when memory injection kicks in, and where data lives. Use when the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?".

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把每次 Read、Edit、Bash 操作变成一条压缩的观察记录,并在会话结束时汇总。相关记录会自动注入到以后的提示里,让下一次会话直接带着上次的上下文开始,不用重新解释代码库。
howto.when: 在同一项目里开到第二次会话时,记忆注入就会开始;第一次会话负责铺底。也可以运行 /learn-codebase,用大约 5 分钟一次性把整个仓库装进记忆。

say.note: 它会说明观察记录的生成与注入方式。

say.text: 这些记忆数据存在哪里?
say.note: 回答 ~/.claude-mem 目录及卸载时清除。

say.text: 帮我把整个仓库预载进记忆

howto.what_en: Every Read, Edit, and Bash Claude makes becomes a compressed observation, summarized at session end. Relevant ones are auto-injected into later prompts, so a new session starts with context from the previous one.
howto.when_en: Memory injection starts on your second session in a project; the first session seeds memory. You can optionally run /learn-codebase to load the whole repo at once (~5 minutes).

say_en.note: It explains how observations are made and injected.

say_en.text: Where does the memory data live?
